## Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce

2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

## Actual Behavior
A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

## Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

## Device Information

If available, please include any error messages or logs:
```
Paste error logs here
```

## Frequency
How often does this bug occur?
- [ ] Always
- [ ] Often (more than 50% of the time)
- [ ] Sometimes (less than 50% of the time)
- [ ] Rarely
- [ ] Only once

## Impact
What is the impact of this bug on your workout tracking experience?
- [ ] Critical - App crashes or data loss
- [ ] High - Feature completely unusable
- [ ] Medium - Feature partially works with workarounds
- [ ] Low - Minor annoyance, doesn't affect core functionality

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here, such as:
- When did you first notice this issue?
- Does this happen in specific scenarios?
- Have you tried any workarounds?
- Any recent changes to your device or app settings?

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to make sure this bug hasn't been reported already
- [ ] I have provided all the requested information above
- [ ] I have tested this on the latest version of the app
- [ ] I am willing to help test a fix if needed
